description:
HushTelegram v0.0.6 targets telegram.org's Telegram 12.10.6 (org.telegram.messenger.web) with 18 patches. It takes sponsored messages, search ads, Stories, recommendations and the Premium, gifts and Stars upsells out of Telegram, and keeps its usage reports on your phone. Five new switches start off, so nothing changes until you turn them on.

For notifications, open Telegram's Settings, then Notifications and Sounds, and turn on Keep-Alive Service and Background Connection.

Validation: 512 runtime tests passed locally. All 232 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lints. All 18 patches applied to Telegram 12.10.6 without forcing, and the resource and injected-code checks passed. The patched app ran on a signed-in Android 16 phone.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.32.0 or newer. Patch telegram.org's Telegram 12.10.6, version code 71129. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Telegram APK. Uninstall the stock Telegram first, and keep the manager's signing key for updates.
